bge.runtime: existing Ollama binary, own isolated daemon11583 and copied verified model store

runtime.host: local8-vCPU16GiB VM, record live before run; not Hetzner4-vCPU or Mac acceptance
runtime.os_cache: not dropped; process-cold is not OS-cold
runtime.network: Jina inference uses verified local snapshots with HF offline, no credential environment; no hosted inference
runtime.inference_network: Linux seccomp denies AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket creation in Jina worker after offline snapshot staging; no hosted provider
runtime.memory_control: Parent RSS+MemAvailable watchdog; stop owned child before reserve drops below2GiB. No daemon changes.

ranking.primary: no reranker; exact cosine vector-only top10; report separately actual product hybrid with same corpus/candidate budget and lexical configuration
ranking.unsupported: no relevance; excluded from recall denominator; report ranking/no-abstention limits, never label retrieval as supported answer
ranking.reduced_dimension_normalization: truncate Jina full vector to256 and L2-renormalize; separate space, not production replacement
ranking.all_required_definition: each required_groups alternative set must have at least one result; independent facts use separate groups

failure_policy.partial: retain attempted successes, failures and unattempted denominators
failure_policy.model_failure: preserve logs, classified stage and actual exit; no substitute model
failure_policy.quality_claim: only actual successfully computed observations; missing model is undecided
failure_policy.recommendation: retain BGE unless measured heldout retrieval gains and operational costs justify adoption; commercial license separate
failure_policy.physical_acceptance: not a re-run of68/92 SLA, no production activation

safe_substitution: reuse existing profiles/generation APIs on an owned populated multi-user/domain copy; original-row hashes, strict restore and control probes; real model vectors may be replayed for recovery, and replay is explicitly distinct from inference latency
